categories.name: Telemetry & Privacy
categories.description: Diagnostic data collection, feedback, advertising and AI data analysis.

categories.name: Xbox & Gaming
categories.description: Xbox Live services and Game DVR. Safe to disable if you don't use Xbox apps or Game Pass.

categories.name: Dev Performance
categories.description: Tweaks that speed up builds, npm/cargo installs and heavy AI-assisted dev sessions.

categories.name: Search & Indexing
categories.description: Background indexing and prefetch services that hammer the disk during big builds.

categories.name: Rarely Used Features
categories.description: Services for hardware or features most dev machines never use.

categories.name: Updates & Delivery
categories.description: Control how Windows Update behaves. Windows Update itself is never disabled.

categories.name: Custom (from Process Analyzer)
categories.description: Services you chose to disable from the Processes tab.

tweaks.name: Connected User Experiences & Telemetry (DiagTrack)
tweaks.description: Main Windows telemetry service. Sends usage and diagnostic data to Microsoft.

tweaks.name: WAP Push Message Routing (dmwappushservice)
tweaks.description: Routes device-management push messages; used by telemetry.

tweaks.name: Telemetry level policy = minimum
tweaks.description: Sets AllowTelemetry policy to 0 (Security/minimum) and disables feedback notifications.

tweaks.name: Telemetry scheduled tasks
tweaks.description: Compatibility Appraiser, CEIP, Disk Diagnostic and Feedback tasks that wake up and scan the disk.

tweaks.name: Advertising ID & tailored experiences
tweaks.description: Disables the per-user advertising ID and ads/tips based on diagnostic data.

tweaks.name: Activity history
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from recording and uploading your app/file activity timeline.

tweaks.name: Recall snapshots / AI data analysis
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Recall screen snapshots (continuous screenshots + OCR indexing).

tweaks.name: Windows Copilot sidebar
tweaks.description: Turns off the built-in Windows Copilot via policy. Does not affect Claude or other AI tools.

tweaks.name: Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops crash dumps being collected and uploaded. Crash reports for your own apps won't be sent to Microsoft either.

tweaks.name: Xbox Live services
tweaks.description: Xbox auth, cloud saves, networking. Disable if you don't play Xbox / Game Pass titles on this PC.

tweaks.name: Xbox Accessory Management
tweaks.description: Needed only for Xbox controllers' firmware/config app.
tweaks.warning: Xbox controllers still work as gamepads, but the Xbox Accessories app won't.

tweaks.name: Game DVR / background recording
tweaks.description: Prevents Game Bar background capture which costs GPU and disk.

tweaks.name: Enable long paths (>260 chars)
tweaks.description: Fixes deep node_modules / cargo target path errors.

tweaks.name: High performance power plan
tweaks.description: Keeps CPU clocks up during builds instead of ramping down.
tweaks.warning: Uses more power and makes laptops warmer; battery life drops.

tweaks.name: Defender exclusions for dev folders
tweaks.description: Skips real-time scanning of the folders listed in Settings (projects, .cargo, .rustup, npm-cache). Huge speedup for npm install / cargo build.
tweaks.warning: Files inside these folders are not scanned on access. Only list folders containing code you trust.

tweaks.name: Defender exclusions for dev toolchain processes
tweaks.description: Skips scanning of files opened by node, cargo, rustc, git, python and claude.
tweaks.warning: Anything these processes open (including a malicious npm package's files) will not be scanned. Prefer folder exclusions unless you really need this.

tweaks.name: Block Store apps running in background
tweaks.description: Stops UWP/Store apps (Weather, News, Phone Link...) from running when not open.
tweaks.warning: Store apps like Mail, Teams (new) or Phone Link won't deliver notifications while closed.

tweaks.name: Disable NTFS last-access timestamps
tweaks.description: Avoids a metadata write on every file read; helps with huge node_modules trees.
tweaks.warning: Tools that rely on last-access time (rare backup/cleanup tools) lose that info. Takes effect after reboot.

tweaks.name: Windows Search indexer (WSearch)
tweaks.description: Indexer constantly re-reads files during builds and git checkouts.
tweaks.warning: Start-menu and Explorer file search become slower (non-indexed). Outlook search depends on it.

tweaks.name: SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: Preloads apps into RAM. On SSD + heavy dev load it mostly costs disk I/O and memory.
tweaks.warning: On HDD machines app launches get noticeably slower. Leave enabled if you have a spinning disk.

tweaks.name: Fax
tweaks.description: Fax service.

tweaks.name: Retail Demo
tweaks.description: Store display demo mode.

tweaks.name: Remote Registry
tweaks.description: Lets remote users edit this PC's registry. Also a security improvement to disable.

tweaks.name: Downloaded Maps Manager
tweaks.description: Background map downloads for the Maps app.

tweaks.name: Windows Media Player network sharing
tweaks.description: DLNA media sharing.

tweaks.name: Distributed Link Tracking Client
tweaks.description: Tracks NTFS shortcut targets across network shares.

tweaks.name: Geolocation service
tweaks.description: Location for apps.
tweaks.warning: Weather, Maps, 'Find my device' and automatic time-zone won't know your location.

tweaks.name: Phone service
tweaks.description: Telephony state for Phone Link calls.
tweaks.warning: Phone Link calling from the PC stops working.

tweaks.name: Program Compatibility Assistant
tweaks.description: Monitors programs for known compatibility issues; scans every exe you run (including build outputs).
tweaks.warning: You won't get 'this program might not have installed correctly' compatibility prompts.

tweaks.name: SSDP Discovery / UPnP Host
tweaks.description: Network device discovery (UPnP).
tweaks.warning: Network media devices / some smart TVs and casting targets may not be discovered.

tweaks.name: Windows Insider Service
tweaks.description: Only needed for Windows Insider builds.
tweaks.warning: Don't disable if you are enrolled in Windows Insider.

tweaks.name: Diagnostic Policy Service
tweaks.description: Problem detection & troubleshooting; runs periodic diagnostics.
tweaks.warning: Windows troubleshooters stop working and Task Manager's network usage per app may disappear.

tweaks.name: Print Spooler
tweaks.description: Printing. Also has a long history of security vulnerabilities.
tweaks.warning: You will NOT be able to print or 'Print to PDF' until restored.

tweaks.name: Bluetooth Support Service
tweaks.description: Bluetooth discovery and pairing.
tweaks.warning: Bluetooth mice, keyboards and headsets will stop working.

tweaks.name: Delivery Optimization: no peer-to-peer
tweaks.description: Stops Windows uploading updates to other PCs (bandwidth + disk). Updates still download normally from Microsoft.

tweaks.name: No auto-restart while signed in
tweaks.description: Windows Update won't reboot the PC in the middle of a long dev/agent session while you're logged on.
tweaks.warning: Updates wait for you to restart manually, so remember to reboot occasionally.

tweaks.name: Exclude drivers from Windows Update
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows Update from replacing GPU/chipset drivers you installed yourself.
tweaks.warning: You become responsible for driver updates, including security fixes.
